description: Live snowfall through the taxi windshield on the verified Helsinki city street, two temporal frames
why: The existing city-centre street taxi pose faces a street with nearby 3D roads, facades, traffic and lights. January snow is sampled at eye height so individual particles can be recognized; settled map and emitting GPU precipitation are checked again after the temporal interval.
audit_readiness: production readiness plus server map_loading empty and HUD banner hidden
